description: This source file defines no-operation implementations of stream checkpointing interfaces used in EventDataGeneratorStreamProvider, specifically the NoOpCheckpointer and its factory NoOpCheckpointerFactory. These classes are used for scenarios where checkpointing is not required or supported.

classes.name: NoOpCheckpointerFactory
classes.description: A factory class that provides a singleton instance of NoOpCheckpointer, implementing IStreamQueueCheckpointerFactory.

classes.name: NoOpCheckpointer
classes.description: A checkpointer class implementing IStreamQueueCheckpointer<string> with no operational behavior, used in scenarios where checkpointing is unnecessary.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and returns a Task with a singleton NoOpCheckpointer instance, ignoring the partition parameter.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Returns a Task with a constant string indicating the start of the stream.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: A no-op method that does nothing; intended to satisfy the interface without performing any action.
